evidence.detail: 1 row over real git repositories: two clones of DIFFERENT repositories, each enrolled through the real call, resolve to their own store and not to each other's; a linked worktree resolves to the same store as the clone it belongs to, because separate working copies of one clone are one enrolled clone; and a binding edited after signing is refused as signature_invalid. DRIVEN: a copy with the signature check skipped hands back the edited binding's store, which reduces the whole record to a file anyone can write.

1 row with every ambient source pointed at a second repository that is REAL and REALLY enrolled against a second store: the process standing inside it, VELDO_CONTROL_DB naming its store, and GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR and GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY all naming it. Those four are the point, and this row CAUGHT A DEFECT IN THIS ITEM BEFORE IT LANDED: each of them overrides `git -C`, so the module's own `git -C repoA rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD` answered repoB's root commit while believing it had named repoA, and the identity check compared the wrong repository against the binding. _git now strips every GIT_ variable by PREFIX, and the row asserts the source reads the environment in exactly one place and only to take values away. DRIVEN twice: a copy resolving from the process's current directory, and against the repository's own file, _git no longer stripping the environment.

1 row, both replacement shapes, with the old binding restored into the new directory either way. A clone of a DIFFERENT repository fails on root commits. A FRESH CLONE OF THE SAME repository has the same root commits and is still refused, because the clone uuid git never tracked did not come with it; that case is why identity is two things rather than one. The refusal creates no store and no ledger, asserted by listing the directory afterwards. DRIVEN: a copy with the repository identity check skipped accepts the swapped directory and hands back the authority of a repository that is no longer there.

1 row: all TEN reasons in the module's own closed list are produced by a real binding and a real workspace rather than a hand-built record, each refusal names its own reason, and the row asserts the list is EXHAUSTED so a reason added later without a case fails it. The refusal carries the workspace, the binding path and the value it objected to. DRIVEN: a copy that returns the store alongside the problems hands a caller a path it may not use, which is worse than no answer because it looks like one.
